meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 它会先问你碰到的是四种症状里的哪一种，再按分支带你排查工具调用问题：模型不调用工具、参数传错、循环停不下来，或从零设计 function schema 的五步法。它只做诊断和指路，不替你写代码。
howto.when: 当你做 tool-calling agent 卡住时接管，例如说「LLM 不呼叫我的 tool」「我的 schema 哪里写坏了」「args 不对」等。framework、MCP server、生产监控这几类问题它不处理，会转介到别处。

say.text: 我的 LLM 不呼叫我的 tool，一直用自然语言回答
say.note: 进入 (a) 分支，查 description 与工具边界

say.text: tool 被调用了但参数传错，帮我看看 schema
我要从零设计一个 function schema，教我步骤
say.note: 进入 (d) 分支，走五步设计法

howto.what_en: It asks which of four symptoms you hit, then walks you through branch-specific diagnosis: tool not called, wrong arguments, runaway loop, or five-step schema design. It diagnoses and points to examples; it won't write code for you.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you're stuck building a tool-calling agent — “the LLM won't call my tool”, “my schema is broken”, “args are wrong”. Framework, MCP and observability questions are routed away.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool, it just answers in plain text
The tool gets called but the arguments are wrong
Help me design a function schema from scratch
